title: Discrete Double-Bracket Flows for Isotropic-Noise Invariant Eigendecomposition
summary: We study eigendecomposition on $SO(n)$ under streaming observations $C_k = C_{\mathrm{sig}} + σ_k^2 I + E_k$, where the isotropic background $σ_k^2 I$ may be time-varying and arbitrarily large. Standard algorithms couple their stability to $\lVert C_k \rVert_2 \approx σ^2$, forcing step sizes, contraction rates, and iteration counts to degrade with the noise floor. We observe that $σ^2 I$ lies in the center of the matrix algebra and therefore *should never enter* the eigenspace dynamics.
